blok_gaya_saat_ini.teks: Illustrate exactly this scene for an educational book: {brief}. Clean flat educational cartoon illustration, clear dark outlines around every shape, simple rounded forms, one clear focal subject with generous empty space around it, calm controlled colors - deep navy and warm orange accents - on a clean pure white background (hex #FFFFFF). No text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no gradients, no 3D render, no photorealism, no cream or beige tint.

gambar.jangkar_konsistensi: Consistent series style for the whole book: the same flat educational cartoon style, the same deep navy and warm orange palette, and if a person appears, the same simple character design in every illustration.
